title: Exotic Spicy Korean Myeongnan-roe Noodles
description: A spicy and crumbly Korean dish featuring myeongnan-roe, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is also ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Bring a large copper pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Add the whisked gochujang sauce to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the myeongnan-roe, crushed red pepper, and green onions, cooking for 1 minute.
Season with salt to taste, then serve immediately.
Garnish with additional green onions and crushed red pepper, if desired.
